sloka: स तं परित्यज्य महारथो रथं सकार्मुकः खड्गधरः खमुत्पतन् ।तपोभियोगादृषिरुग्रवीर्यवान् विहाय देहं मरुतामिवालयम् ।। ५.४७.३३।।।।
transliteration: sa taṁ parityajya mahāratho rathaṁ sakārmukaḥ khaḍgadharaḥ khamutpatan ।tapobhiyogādṛṣirugravīryavān vihāya dehaṁ marutāmivālayam ।। 5.47.33।।।।

translations.english: (Aksha) the great charioteer abandoned the chariot, held a sword and a bow, and flew up to the region of the sky with his fierce power just as a sage with his fearsome ascetic power ascends to heaven, leaving his body.
translations.hindi: जिसने सोता को हरा है उसको में उच्छिन्न करूंगा घर्थात्‌ नाश करूँगा । फिर यदि इन्द्र ही क्यों न न हो और श्रौरामचन्द्रजी का भ्रपकार करें तो
